id.description: Username, case-sensitive and unique. Only users who have posted have a profile.

response.title: User
response.description: The public half of a profile. Everything private -- email, votes, saved items -- is not served by this API at all.

about.description: The user's self-description, as HTML. Absent when they have not written one.

submitted.description: Ids of everything the user has submitted -- stories, comments, polls -- newest first. Long for an active account.

unverified.detail: Written from the Hacker News API documentation and the live endpoint's own shape, with no recording committed yet. The Record workflow replays `examples/*.request.json` through a client generated from this spec and fills in the responses.

notes: An unknown username answers `null` with HTTP 200, the same way an unknown item id does.
`submitted` is the whole history in one array, with no paging of any kind: an active account's profile is a large response, and there is no parameter that makes it smaller.
